Title: Indexation lock — a second Build right after a completed Build also completes (lock released)
Section: Search Indexation Jobs > Index Management > IndexationJob lock
Preconditions: Search module with the IndexationJob lock guard (introduced by VCST-6429); admin account; no indexation currently running (state, not a prior case)
Steps:
[AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token grant_type=password username={{ADMIN_EMAIL}} password={{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}; [CAPTURE] access_token as the Bearer token for every call below
[SETUP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/search/indexes; [CAPTURE] Product row indexedDocumentsCount as C0
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/search/indexes/index body [{"documentType":"Product","deleteExistingIndex":false}]; [CAPTURE] response id as RUN1_ID
[WAIT] poll POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/pushnotifications body {"ids":["{RUN1_ID}"]} and read notifyEvents[0] for RUN1_ID every 3s, up to 300s, until finished = true
[HTTP] immediately after RUN1 finished: POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/search/indexes/index with the same body; [CAPTURE] response id as RUN2_ID
[WAIT] poll POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/pushnotifications body {"ids":["{RUN2_ID}"]} and read notifyEvents[0] for RUN2_ID every 3s, up to 300s, until finished = true
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/search/indexes; [CAPTURE] Product row indexedDocumentsCount as C1
Cross_Layer_Checks: [NETWORK] no unexpected 4xx/5xx on the endpoint under test
Failure_Signals: RUN2 sealed with "Indexation is already in progress." although RUN1 finished (lock never released); RUN2 finished with totalCount 0 or processedCount 0 while errorCount is 0; Product indexedDocumentsCount drops after the runs; RUN notification never reaches finished = true
Cleanup: none - plain Build is idempotent and leaves the index complete

Title: Indexation lock — Delete and build keeps search serving and swaps to a full index
Section: Search Indexation Jobs > Index Management > IndexationJob lock
Preconditions: Search module with the IndexationJob lock guard; blue-green indexing enabled (inactive twin index kept by Delete and build); Category has an active index; admin account; no indexation running (state)
Steps:
[AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token grant_type=password username={{ADMIN_EMAIL}} password={{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}; [CAPTURE] access_token as the Bearer token for every call below
[SETUP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/search/indexes; [CAPTURE] Category row indexedDocumentsCount as C0 and lastIndexationDate as D0
[SETUP] anonymous POST {{BACK_URL}}/graphql query { categories(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}", first: 1) { totalCount } }; [CAPTURE] data.categories.totalCount as X0
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/search/indexes/index body [{"documentType":"Category","deleteExistingIndex":true}] (Delete and build is run on Category only); [CAPTURE] response id as RUN_ID
[WAIT] while RUN_ID is not finished (poll POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/pushnotifications body {"ids":["{RUN_ID}"]} and read notifyEvents[0] every 3s, up to 300s): repeat the anonymous categories query every 10s; [CAPTURE] each totalCount as X_during
[WAIT] poll POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/pushnotifications body {"ids":["{RUN_ID}"]} and read notifyEvents[0] for RUN_ID every 3s, up to 300s, until finished = true
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/search/indexes; [CAPTURE] Category row (isActive = true) indexedDocumentsCount as C1 and lastIndexationDate as D1
[HTTP] anonymous POST {{BACK_URL}}/graphql with the categories query again; [CAPTURE] totalCount as X1
Cross_Layer_Checks: [NETWORK] no unexpected 4xx/5xx on the endpoint under test
Failure_Signals: RUN finished with errorCount > 0 or "Indexation has been canceled" (lockToken cancelled before the swap); C1 = 0 or C1 < C0 (partial index swapped in); any X_during sample = 0 or errors[]; D1 not later than D0 (build skipped but reported successful)
Cleanup: If the run aborted before completion: POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/search/indexes/index body [{"documentType":"Category","deleteExistingIndex":true}] and wait for "Indexation completed successfully", so Category is left with a full active index

Title: Indexation lock — single product Build index (documentIds) completes and updates that product's index document
Section: Search Indexation Jobs > Index Management > IndexationJob lock
Preconditions: Search module with the IndexationJob lock guard; Product index active; no indexation running (state)
Steps:
[AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token grant_type=password username={{ADMIN_EMAIL}} password={{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}; [CAPTURE] access_token as the Bearer token for every call below
[SETUP] live-discover a product: POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/catalog/search/products body {"take":1,"skip":0,"responseGroup":"None"}; [CAPTURE] items[0].id as PRODUCT_ID
[SETUP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/search/indexes/index/Product/{PRODUCT_ID}; [CAPTURE] first element indexationdate as D0 (the stand returns an array of index documents)
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/search/indexes/index body [{"documentType":"Product","documentIds":["{PRODUCT_ID}"],"deleteExistingIndex":false}] (the per-product Build index action); [CAPTURE] response id as DOC_ID; then re-read A_ID once: if A is already finished at that moment the race was lost (the second run may have found the lock free) - result BLOCKED, not FAIL
[WAIT] poll POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/pushnotifications body {"ids":["{DOC_ID}"]} and read notifyEvents[0] for DOC_ID every 3s, up to 120s, until finished = true
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/search/indexes/index/Product/{PRODUCT_ID}; [CAPTURE] indexationdate as D1
Cross_Layer_Checks: [NETWORK] no unexpected 4xx/5xx on the endpoint under test
Failure_Signals: DOC sealed successful but D1 equals D0 (silent no-op); errorCount > 0 with no running indexation; DOC notification never finishes; GET returns an empty array after the build
Cleanup: none - re-indexing one existing product changes no data

Title: Indexation lock — Build started while another Build holds the lock is sealed with 'already in progress' and indexes nothing
Section: Search Indexation Jobs > Index Management > IndexationJob lock
Preconditions: Search module with the IndexationJob lock guard; Product has enough documents that a plain Build stays running for several seconds; admin account; no indexation running (state)
Steps:
[AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token grant_type=password username={{ADMIN_EMAIL}} password={{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}; [CAPTURE] access_token as the Bearer token for every call below
[SETUP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/search/indexes; [CAPTURE] Product row indexedDocumentsCount as C0
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/search/indexes/index body [{"documentType":"Product","deleteExistingIndex":false}] (plain Build, never Delete and build on Product); [CAPTURE] response id as A_ID and jobId as A_JOB
[WAIT] poll POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/pushnotifications body {"ids":["{A_ID}"]} and read notifyEvents[0] for A_ID every 2s, up to 120s, until totalCount > 0 and finished = false. If A is already finished or totalCount stays 0, the race is not set up: result BLOCKED, not PASS
[HTTP] while A is still running: POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/search/indexes/index body [{"documentType":"Product","deleteExistingIndex":false}]; [CAPTURE] response id as B_ID; then re-read A_ID once: if A is already finished at that moment the race was lost (the second run may have found the lock free) - result BLOCKED, not FAIL
[WAIT] poll POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/pushnotifications body {"ids":["{B_ID}"]} and read notifyEvents[0] for B_ID every 3s, up to 30s, until finished = true
[CAPTURE] B notification at this moment as B_EARLY (errorCount, errors[], description, processedCount)
[WAIT] poll POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/pushnotifications body {"ids":["{A_ID}"]} and read notifyEvents[0] for A_ID every 3s, up to 300s, until finished = true
[CAPTURE] A_ID notification as A_FINAL
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/search/indexes; [CAPTURE] Product row indexedDocumentsCount as C1
Cross_Layer_Checks: [NETWORK] no unexpected 4xx/5xx on the endpoint under test
Failure_Signals: B finished with errorCount 0 and a success description (loser reports success while indexing nothing - the VP-9334 symptom); B never reaches finished = true; A_FINAL errored or canceled because of the second request; C1 < C0
Cleanup: Wait until A_ID is finished before leaving the case; if A failed, POST a plain Build on Product and wait for "Indexation completed successfully"

Title: Indexation lock — cancelling a running Build seals it as canceled and the next Build completes
Section: Search Indexation Jobs > Index Management > IndexationJob lock
Preconditions: Search module with the IndexationJob lock guard; Product Build runs long enough to be cancelled mid-run; no indexation running (state)
Steps:
[AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token grant_type=password username={{ADMIN_EMAIL}} password={{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}; [CAPTURE] access_token as the Bearer token for every call below
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/search/indexes/index body [{"documentType":"Product","deleteExistingIndex":false}] (plain Build, never Delete and build on Product); [CAPTURE] response id as A_ID and jobId as A_JOB
[WAIT] poll POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/pushnotifications body {"ids":["{A_ID}"]} and read notifyEvents[0] for A_ID every 2s, up to 120s, until totalCount > 0 and finished = false. If A is already finished or totalCount stays 0, the race is not set up: result BLOCKED, not PASS
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/search/indexes/tasks/{A_JOB}/cancel
[WAIT] poll POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/pushnotifications body {"ids":["{A_ID}"]} and read notifyEvents[0] for A_ID every 3s, up to 60s, until finished = true
[CAPTURE] A notification as A_FINAL
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/search/indexes/index body [{"documentType":"Product","deleteExistingIndex":false}]; [CAPTURE] response id as NEXT_ID
[WAIT] poll POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/pushnotifications body {"ids":["{NEXT_ID}"]} and read notifyEvents[0] for NEXT_ID every 3s, up to 300s, until finished = true
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/search/indexes; [CAPTURE] Product row indexedDocumentsCount as C1
Cross_Layer_Checks: [NETWORK] no unexpected 4xx/5xx on the endpoint under test
Failure_Signals: A finishes as "Indexation completed successfully" after the cancel call (cancel no longer stops the run); A never reaches finished = true; NEXT sealed with "Indexation is already in progress." (cancelled run left the lock held); C1 = 0
Cleanup: The closing plain Build (NEXT) leaves Product fully indexed; if it did not complete, POST a plain Build on Product and wait for "Indexation completed successfully"
